title: EC49001: Microcontroller Systems Laboratory
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

1. Write a program in assembly langauge of 8051 to find the second largest in
an array of 10 numbers stored from a memory location.2. Design a traffic light
controller.3. Design a digital clock.4. Show the operation of interrupt
facility of ARM board.5. Communicate between the two SPI ports of ARM to
exchange data bytes.6. Interface an ADC to the ARM processor. Use the interface
to measure the frequency of slow running sine wave.7. Interface a stepper motor
with the ARM processor.
